name: The Pure Low-Carb Meat & Chocolate Shake
ingredients: 1 tbsp beef tallow or MCT oil
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend until smooth and fully combined.
Pour and serve immediately.
note: A wellness-aligned protein shake built around collagen and bone broth.

name: Keto Bolognese with Konjac Spaghetti
steps: Melt tallow in a pan and saute onion and garlic until soft.
Add ground beef and brown fully.
Stir in sauce, simmer 10 minutes.
Rinse and warm konjac spaghetti separately, drain well.
Serve bolognese over the spaghetti.

name: Keto Carrot Cake
ingredients: Cake: 2 cups superfine blanched almond flour
Cake: 3/4 cup brown sugar keto sweetener
steps: Preheat oven to 350F (175C). Line two 8-inch springform pans with parchment and grease the sides.
Whisk eggs, melted butter and vanilla until smooth.
Add almond flour, coconut flour, sweetener, baking powder, cinnamon and nutmeg; stir to a smooth batter.
Fold in freshly grated carrots and pecans (use freshly grated carrots, not pre-shredded).
Divide between pans and bake 25-30 min until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely in the pans before removing - do not frost while warm.
Beat cream cheese, powdered sweetener, butter, heavy cream and vanilla until smooth and lump-free.
Frost between layers and on top, garnish with pecans, chill 30-60 min before slicing.
note: Use a brown sugar keto substitute (Lakanto Golden or Swerve Brown) for best flavour and moisture. Refrigerates up to 5 days; freeze unfrosted slices up to 3 months.

name: Keto Cheesecake
ingredients: Crust: 2 cups superfine blanched almond flour
Filling: 32 oz full-fat cream cheese, softened (4 blocks)
Filling: 1 cup powdered keto sweetener (Swerve / allulose)
Filling: 1/4 cup sour cream or heavy cream
steps: Preheat oven to 325F (160C). Line the base of a 9-inch springform pan with parchment, grease the sides.
Stir almond flour, melted butter, powdered sweetener, vanilla and salt into coarse crumbs.
Press into base and 1 inch up the sides; chill 20 min (or pre-bake at 350F for 10 min).
Beat cream cheese until completely smooth and fluffy.
Add powdered sweetener, sour cream, vanilla, lemon juice and salt; mix on low until incorporated.
Add eggs one at a time on low speed - do not overmix, this causes cracks.
Pour filling over crust and bake 50-60 min until edges are set with a gentle wobble in the centre.
Turn off oven, crack the door, leave 30 min, then cool to room temperature before chilling 4-6 hrs (overnight best).
note: All filling ingredients must be at room temperature to avoid lumps. Refrigerates up to 5 days.

name: Keto Chocolate Cake
ingredients: Cake: 2 cups superfine blanched almond flour
Cake: 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder (natural, not Dutch-process)
Cake: 3/4 cup granulated keto sweetener (allulose or monk fruit blend)
Cake: 1/4 cup hot water or brewed coffee
Frosting: 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, sifted
steps: Preheat oven to 350F (175C). Grease two 9-inch round pans, line bottoms with parchment.
Make the frosting first: beat butter until fluffy, add cocoa, sweetener, cream, vanilla and salt, beat smooth; set aside.
Beat softened butter and sweetener until pale and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time, then vanilla and sour cream.
Sift in almond flour, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda and salt; mix on low until just combined.
Stir in hot water or coffee gently - the batter will be thick.
Bake 25-30 min until a toothpick comes out clean; check at 22 min as almond flour burns quickly.
Cool in pans 10 min, then on a wire rack at least 1 hour before frosting.
Frost between layers, top and sides. Chill 30-60 min for clean slices.
note: Natural (non-alkalized) cocoa reacts with baking soda to help the rise. Hot coffee instead of water deepens the chocolate flavour without tasting of coffee.

name: Keto Coconut Cake
ingredients: Cake: 2 cups superfine blanched almond flour
Cake: 3/4 cup granulated keto sweetener (allulose or monk fruit blend)
Frosting: 1/2 cup unsweetened shredded coconut (for topping, toasted)
steps: Preheat oven to 350F (175C). Grease two 8-inch pans, line bottoms with parchment, dust with almond flour.
Beat butter and sweetener until pale and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time, then sour cream, vanilla and coconut extract.
Add almond flour, coconut flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt; mix on low just until combined.
Fold in shredded coconut - the batter will be thick.
Divide between pans, bake 25-30 min until a toothpick comes out clean and edges are lightly golden.
Cool in pans 10 min, then on a wire rack at least 1 hour before frosting.
Beat cream cheese and butter smooth, add powdered sweetener, cream, vanilla and coconut extract; beat until fluffy.
Frost between layers, top and sides. Press toasted shredded coconut all over the outside. Chill 30-60 min.
note: Toasting the coconut topping in a dry pan for 2-3 min transforms the flavour.

name: Keto Lemon Cake
ingredients: Cake: 2 cups superfine blanched almond flour
Cake: 3/4 cup granulated keto sweetener (allulose or monk fruit blend)
Cake: 3 tbsp fresh lemon juice (about 1 1/2 lemons)
steps: Preheat oven to 350F (175C). Grease two 8-inch pans and line bottoms with parchment.
Beat butter and sweetener until pale and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time.
Mix in sour cream, lemon juice, lemon zest, vanilla and lemon extract - a slightly curdled look is fine.
Add almond flour, coconut flour, baking powder and salt; mix on low until just combined.
Divide between pans, bake 25-30 min until a toothpick comes out clean and edges are lightly golden.
Cool in pans 10 min, then on a wire rack at least 1 hour before frosting.
Beat cream cheese and butter smooth. Add powdered sweetener, lemon juice, zest, vanilla and salt; beat until fluffy.
Frost between layers, top and sides. Garnish with lemon slices and zest. Chill 30-60 min before slicing.
note: Use freshly squeezed lemon juice and freshly grated zest for the best brightness.

name: Sardine Scrambled Eggs
ingredients: 1 tin sardines in olive oil, drained
1 tbsp beef tallow or the sardine oil
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of Celtic salt.
Melt tallow in a pan over medium-low heat.
Pour in the eggs and let them sit a few seconds before gently pushing curds from the edges to the centre.
When the eggs are just short of set, fold in the sardines to warm through - don't overmix or they'll break down too much.
Take off the heat while still glossy (they keep cooking), season with pepper and a squeeze of lemon.
note: A quick, high-protein way to work sardines into the egg rotation.

name: Spinach & Cheese Scrambled Eggs
ingredients: 1 heaped cup fresh spinach, roughly chopped
steps: Melt tallow in a pan over medium heat.
Add spinach and saute 1-2 minutes until just wilted, then push to one side of the pan.
Whisk eggs with salt and pour into the pan.
Scramble gently, folding the wilted spinach through as the eggs set.
Off the heat, fold in the grated cheese so it melts from residual warmth. Finish with pepper.
note: Cook the spinach first so it doesn't water down the eggs.

name: Baked Eggs with Spinach and Sardines
ingredients: 1 tin sardines in olive oil, drained and roughly broken up
steps: Preheat oven to 375F (190C).
Melt tallow in an oven-safe small pan or ramekin dish and wilt the spinach for 1-2 minutes.
Scatter the sardines over the spinach.
Crack the eggs on top, season with salt, pepper and chilli flakes if using.
Bake 10-12 minutes until whites are set and yolks are still soft. Serve straight from the dish.

name: Creamy Spinach Scramble with Collagen
ingredients: 1 tbsp heavy cream or full-fat cream cheese
steps: Melt tallow in a pan over medium-low heat and wilt the spinach.
Whisk eggs with the cream and collagen until smooth.
Pour into the pan with the spinach and scramble slowly over low heat for the creamiest texture.
Season with Celtic salt and pepper, remove while still soft.
note: Stirring collagen straight into the eggs is an easy way to fold it into the daily routine.
